strings.zh: 你也一定想{NEWLINE}成为最强的训练师吧？{CLEAR}那我们交个朋友吧！{SCROLL}对了！我有时会在岸边{NEWLINE}捡到好东西,{CLEAR}你也想不想要一个啊！{SCROLL}来,和我交换一下{NEWLINE}电话号码吧。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You must want to be the strongest{NEWLINE}Trainer too, right?{SCROLL}Then let’s be friends! Oh, I know! I{NEWLINE}sometimes find good stuff on the shore.{SCROLL}Do you want one? Come on,{NEWLINE}let’s trade phone numbers. {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0694/1 | RV072: omission: restored friends/offer clauses; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 我捡到好东西的话{NEWLINE}会打电话联系你的！
strings.en: You’ll be hearing from me if I find{NEWLINE}something good.

strings.zh: 是吗？那我还是{NEWLINE}一个人独吞算了⋯⋯
strings.en: Is that so? Then I’ll just have to use{NEWLINE}them myself.

strings.zh: 我在岸边捡到什么{NEWLINE}好东西的话就给你吧！{SCROLL}要是你乐意的话,{NEWLINE}我们交换一下电话号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: If I find anything good on the shore,{NEWLINE}I’ll give it to you!{SCROLL}If you’re up for it,{NEWLINE}let’s trade phone numbers! {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0694/4 | RV072: softened: polite request restored; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 哦,你来了啊！{SCROLL}这是之前说好了的,{NEWLINE}送给你！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hey, there you are!{NEWLINE}Here’s a gift, as promised!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎？要是你在附近的话,{NEWLINE}直接来找我聊天吧！
strings.en: Hey, if you’re nearby, come and chat{NEWLINE}with me in person!

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}又长大了！{SCROLL}我刚抓到它的时候{NEWLINE}它才那么~~点,{CLEAR}想不到现在长到这么大了！{SCROLL}对了,我之前把{VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}给打败了,它也很大啊,{CLEAR}有这~~么大！{SCROLL}⋯⋯算了,电话里跟你讲不明白,{SCROLL}下次再聊吧！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} has grown again.{SCROLL}It was only about so big when I caught{NEWLINE}it, but now it’s way bigger.{SCROLL}Oh yeah, I KO’d a wild {VAR:0100:11}.{NEWLINE}It was huge--like THIS big, even.{SCROLL}Heh, I guess you can’t tell over{NEWLINE}the phone...{SCROLL}Well, I’ll be seeing you.

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}又长大了！{SCROLL}我刚抓到它的时候{NEWLINE}它才那么~~点,{CLEAR}想不到现在长到这么大了！{SCROLL}对了,之前跑掉的{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}也很大了,{CLEAR}差不多有这~~么大！{SCROLL}⋯⋯算了,电话里跟你讲不明白,{SCROLL}下次再聊吧！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} has grown again.{SCROLL}It was only about so big when I caught{NEWLINE}it, but now it’s way bigger.{SCROLL}Oh yeah, I lost a wild {VAR:0100:11}.{NEWLINE}It was huge--like THIS big, even.{SCROLL}Heh, I guess you can’t tell over{NEWLINE}the phone...{SCROLL}Well, I’ll be seeing you.

strings.zh: 差不多我们该{NEWLINE}再来一次精灵对战了！{SCROLL}我一直都会在{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}钓鱼的,{CLEAR}有空了就来吧。
strings.en: We should get a battle going!{SCROLL}I’ll be fishing on {VAR:0104:3}.{NEWLINE}Swing by if you have time.

strings.zh: 你怎么了？迷路了？{NEWLINE}我们的精灵对战{CLEAR}是在{VAR:0104:3}啊！
strings.en: What’s wrong? Are you lost?{SCROLL}Our battle is on {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 你问我有没有捡到好东西？{NEWLINE}还没呢,{SCROLL}这个跟钓鱼一样,{NEWLINE}心急吃不了热豆腐！
strings.en: Have I found anything good?{NEWLINE}Nope, not yet.{SCROLL}It’s like fishing--you need patience.

strings.zh: 我在岸边捡到了好东西,{SCROLL}这个送你吧！{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3}。
strings.en: I picked up a cool little thing at the{NEWLINE}water’s edge. As promised, it’s yours.{CLEAR}I’ll be waiting on {VAR:0104:3}.

strings.zh: 我有好东西要送你,{NEWLINE}你赶快{CLEAR}来{VAR:0104:3}吧。
strings.en: I’ve got something good for you.{NEWLINE}Hurry over to {VAR:0104:3}.
